source_result: candidate DC2 (self-organizing field: cellular automata / reaction-diffusion) of GMI_DOMAIN_CANDIDATES_DC1_DC9_V1 section 2; domain criterion of GMI_STRUCTURAL_DOMAINS_KINGDOMS_V1 sections 2 and 14; the B1-A weight-sharing mechanism; continues RV-377-045 (gap DG-2: the reuse grid must reach the analytic crossover of every price vector before a 'no cell exists' clause may be written)
original_hypothesis: the self-organizing-field carrier is NOT a new structural domain: a lattice with one shared local rule is an iterated local map (D6) plus translation-equivariant WEIGHT SHARING, and nothing else. The executable form of that claim is that the weight-sharing-ablated parent — the identical search over the identical 256-entry local-rule hypothesis class, with one independently searched rule table per site — reproduces the field row's answers EXACTLY once it has been given enough data, and that the field's only two advantages are a description smaller by exactly the factor L and a sample requirement smaller by a factor that grows with L. Neither is a new carrier: both are the signature of a shared parameter
minimal_proposed_change: DECLARED microscope gmi_microscope/dc_field.py. Ecology E_spatial(L, T, rule, n_dev): a ring of L cells; development shows n_dev declared trajectories (an initial configuration drawn by the declared LCG and the whole T-step orbit under a hidden elementary rule), so a learner observes n_dev*T single-step transitions; evaluation gives 16 UNSEEN initial configurations and demands the configuration after T = 3 steps EXACTLY (all L bits). Dev and eval initials are disjoint by construction and the receipt reports `eval_initials_unseen` per cell. Rows: FIELD (search over the 256 elementary local rules, served state = THE RULE, 8 bits, one rule shared by every site); FIELD_NONLOCAL (the negative twin: the SAME search over the SAME hypothesis class with the translation-equivariance constraint REMOVED — one independently searched 8-bit rule table per site, served state 8L bits; nothing else differs); TABLE (the D2 parent: memorize the global T-step map as an exact-key store with a charged linear scan; declared default on a miss is the input unchanged); DENSE (the D1 parent: one linear threshold unit per output site over the FLATTENED L-cell configuration — no locality, no sharing — trained by a declared perceptron of 5 passes over the single-step transitions with a disclosed budget cap of the first 16 dev trajectories, then rolled out T steps). Declared prices: NATIVE one op per STEP (a whole synchronous lattice update); REDUCED per site 5 ADD (3-bit neighbourhood index) + 6 SEL (8-entry rule-table mux) = 11 ops, so one STEP costs 11L. Declared search realization: the 256 candidates are filtered against every observed transition with early exit at the first mismatch (the surviving set equals the consistent set of the exhaustive search) and the declared frozen tie-break serves the SMALLEST consistent rule number; the receipt also reports `search_ops_exhaustive_analytic` = 256*n_dev*T*L*12. Declared precision instrument: the wide-integer instrument of gap G5 (perceptron weights leave the 8-bit range). Cells: L in {8,16,32,64} x rule in {110, 30, 90, 232} x n_dev in {1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256} = 144 cells x 4 rows. DISCLOSED CALIBRATION BEFORE FREEZING, stated in full because it was larger than two cells: the L in {8,16,32} x rule in {110,30} x full n_dev grid sub-block was executed during instrument debugging and its FIELD / FIELD_NONLOCAL capabilities, identification counts and n* thresholds were seen, namely n*(FIELD) = 1 in all six groups and n*(FIELD_NONLOCAL) = 8 / 16 / 16 for rule 30 at L = 8 / 16 / 32 and 32 / 128 / 128 for rule 110 at L = 8 / 16 / 32, with answer-signature equality between FIELD and FIELD_NONLOCAL holding exactly in the cells where all L sites were identified; per-cell costs seen (rule 110): L8_n1 FIELD cap 1.0 desc 8 exec/q 264 learn 8064 native 48, FIELD_NONLOCAL cap 0.125 desc 64 exec/q 264 learn 43776, TABLE cap 0.0 desc 16 exec/q 1.625, DENSE cap 0.0 desc 288 exec/q 600 learn 3135; L8_n4 FIELD 1.0/8/264/8928, NL 0.1875/64/264/59856, TABLE 0.0625/64/8.25, DENSE 0.0625/360/600/13125; L16_n1 FIELD 1.0/8/528/8364, NL 0.0/128/528/89088, TABLE 0.0/32/1.625, DENSE 0.0/1088/2352/12168; L16_n4 FIELD 1.0/8/528/10092, NL 0.0/128/528/139344, TABLE 0.0/128/8.625, DENSE 0.0/1632/2352/50406; L32_n1 FIELD 1.0/8/1056/8940, NL 0.0/256/1056/177408, TABLE 0.0/64/1.625, DENSE 0.0/4224/9312/48309; L32_n4 FIELD 1.0/8/1056/12396, NL 0.0/256/1056/255624, TABLE 0.0/256/8.625, DENSE 0.0/6336/9312/195645; plus a single timing probe at L = 64, rule 110, n_dev = 32: DENSE capability 0.0, desc 29120, exec/q 37056, learn 3171310, 3.3 s. NOT SEEN AT FREEZE TIME and therefore the falsifiable part of the record: every cell of rules 90 and 232, every cell at L = 64 except the one DENSE timing probe, every TABLE and DENSE number outside the disclosed list, every frontier and crossover entry, and every receipt-level aggregate.
why_justified: the domain criterion turns on whether a bounded semantics-preserving reduction into an existing domain exists. For a field carrier the candidate reduction is exactly 'drop the shared parameter': the ablated row searches the same hypothesis class site by site, so if it reproduces the field row's answers bit for bit once identified, the field carrier IS D6 plus weight sharing and the whole of its advantage is measurable as two numbers (a description factor and a sample factor). Both rows execute the same charged op sequence per query, so the comparison is not confounded by serve cost
new_prediction_before_outcome: (1) FIELD serves the TRUE hidden rule with n_consistent = 1 in every one of the 144 cells, including n_dev = 1, for all four rules and all four ring sizes; FIELD capability = 1.0 in every cell. (2) exec_per_query(FIELD) = exec_per_query(FIELD_NONLOCAL) = 11*L*T = 33L EXACTLY in every cell (264 / 528 / 1056 / 2112 at L = 8 / 16 / 32 / 64) and native_ops = T*n_eval = 48 for both rows in every cell: the two rows differ in no serve cost whatever. (3) desc(FIELD) = 8 bits in every cell and desc(FIELD_NONLOCAL) = 8L, so the description ratio is EXACTLY L (8, 16, 32, 64), independent of rule, of n_dev and of T. (4) FIELD_NONLOCAL capability = 1.0 if and only if sites_identified = L, and answer_signature(FIELD) == answer_signature(FIELD_NONLOCAL) in EXACTLY the cells where sites_identified = L and in no others: exact developmental equality with the weight-sharing-ablated parent. (5) sample efficiency: n*(FIELD) = 1 in all 16 (L, rule) groups; n*(FIELD_NONLOCAL) >= 8 in every group, is non-decreasing in L for each fixed rule, and n*(FIELD_NONLOCAL)/n*(FIELD) >= 8 in every group; at L = 64 the value is >= the L = 32 value of the same rule. (6) TABLE is inadmissible in all 144 cells, and its capability equals exactly the fraction of the 16 unseen evaluation configurations that are fixed points of the T-step map (0.0625 at L = 8 rule 110, 0.0 at L = 16 and L = 32 rule 110), because dev and eval initials are disjoint (`eval_initials_unseen` true in all 144 cells). (7) DENSE is inadmissible at EVERY n_dev for rules 110, 30 and 90 — each is a non-linearly-separable function of its three-cell neighbourhood (110 and 30 reverse the sign of the left-neighbour dependence as the centre changes; 90 is XOR(l, r)) — and BECOMES admissible (>= 0.85) for rule 232, the majority rule, which is a linear threshold function of the neighbourhood, at some n_dev <= 16 at every L in {8, 16, 32, 64}. (8) DG-2 frontier: FIELD and FIELD_NONLOCAL have IDENTICAL per-query cost under BOTH price vectors, so NO finite reuse-horizon crossover exists between them and the analytic crossover set for that pair is empty; FIELD dominates at every H because its description is smaller by 8(L-1) bits and its learn_ops are smaller. Therefore in every cell where both are admissible FIELD is the SOLE frontier occupant at every H of the extended grid under both the reduced and the declared native price; and in the rule-232 cells where DENSE is also admissible FIELD remains the sole occupant, because desc(DENSE) >= 288 > 8 and exec_per_query(DENSE) > exec_per_query(FIELD) at every L, again giving no crossover. (9) domain verdict: criterion 3 FAILS for DC2. The ablated parent reproduces FIELD's answers exactly once identified, at an overhead of exactly L in description and a measured factor of at least 8 (and growing with L) in samples, both polynomial in the state size; DC2 is a compiled specialization of D6 whose entire content is translation-equivariant weight sharing, and the honest claim level is REDUCED_TO_PARENT(D6 + weight sharing)
new_falsifier: (1) any cell where FIELD does not serve the true rule, or n_consistent != 1, or FIELD capability != 1.0; (2) any cell where exec_per_query differs between FIELD and FIELD_NONLOCAL, or differs from 33L, or native_ops != 48; (3) any cell where the description ratio is not exactly L; (4) any cell where FIELD_NONLOCAL is at 1.0 without all L sites identified, or all L sites identified without answer-signature equality, or answer-signature equality without all L sites identified; (5) n*(FIELD) > 1 in any group, or n*(FIELD_NONLOCAL) < 8 in any group, or a decrease in L at fixed rule, or a ratio below 8; (6) TABLE admissible anywhere, or a TABLE capability that is not the fixed-point fraction, or `eval_initials_unseen` false anywhere; (7) DENSE admissible in any rule-110, rule-30 or rule-90 cell, or DENSE inadmissible at every n_dev <= 16 for rule 232 at any L; (8) any non-empty analytic crossover between FIELD and FIELD_NONLOCAL, or any frontier cell of the extended grid not won by FIELD alone among the admissible rows; (9) any executed number showing the reduction overhead to be super-polynomial in L

observed_outcome: Receipt STAGE_DC_V30_DC2_FIELD.json (sha f98f83ab46684ca3...; 144 cells x 4 rows, 1152 frontier entries, 2 min 50 s). (1) FAILS in part. FIELD serves the true hidden rule and is capability 1.0 in 143 of 144 cells, but n_consistent = 1 fails in 3 cells: L8_r232_n1 (4 consistent rules; the declared smallest-first tie-break serves rule 200 instead of 232 and capability is 0.5), L8_r232_n2 and L8_r90_n1 (2 consistent rules each; the tie-break happens to serve the true rule, capability 1.0). One trajectory is not always enough at L = 8: rule 232 (majority) drives its own orbit to low neighbourhood diversity, so 24 observations leave the rule table under-determined. (2) HOLDS EXACTLY, 0 violations in 144 cells: exec_per_query(FIELD) = exec_per_query(FIELD_NONLOCAL) = 33L = 264 / 528 / 1056 / 2112 at L = 8 / 16 / 32 / 64, and native_ops = 48 for both rows everywhere. The two rows differ in no serve cost whatever. (3) HOLDS EXACTLY in all 144 cells: desc(FIELD) = 8 bits, desc(FIELD_NONLOCAL) = 8L, description ratio exactly L (8, 16, 32, 64), independent of rule, n_dev and T. (4) FAILS as an 'if and only if', HOLDS in its equality half and yields a stronger invariant. answer_signature(FIELD) == answer_signature(FIELD_NONLOCAL) if and only if FIELD_NONLOCAL capability = 1.0, in 144 of 144 cells (60 equal, 84 not). Full site identification is SUFFICIENT for equality (144/144) but NOT NECESSARY: three cells reach exact equality with one site still ambiguous (L16_r232_n32 and L16_r232_n64 at 15/16 sites, L32_r232_n64 at 31/32, max 2 consistent rules at the ambiguous site), because the two surviving candidates agree on every neighbourhood the evaluation rollouts actually visit. (5) FAILS in its first half, HOLDS in the rest. n*(FIELD) = 1 in 15 of 16 (L, rule) groups and 2 in L8_r232. n*(FIELD_NONLOCAL) >= 8 in all 16 groups (8, 16, 16, 32, 32, 32, 32, 32, 32, 32, 128, 128, 128, 128, 128, 128), is non-decreasing in L at fixed rule for all four rules, and the ratio n*(NL)/n*(FIELD) is 8, 16, 32 or 128 in every group; at L = 64 every value is >= its L = 32 value. (6) FAILS in its premise, HOLDS in its verdict. TABLE is inadmissible in all 144 cells (capabilities 0.0 to 0.75), but `eval_initials_unseen` is FALSE in 28 cells, ALL of them at L = 8: the configuration space has only 2^8 = 256 members, so from n_dev = 4 upward the declared LCG draws evaluation initials that also occur in development and TABLE scores legitimate hits up to 0.75. The disjointness guarantee holds in the 116 cells at L >= 16, where TABLE is 0.0 everywhere. This is an ecology defect at L = 8, not a row result. (7) FAILS in its second half. DENSE is inadmissible at every n_dev for rules 110, 30 and 90 (maximum capabilities 0.0625, 0.0625, 0.0) as predicted, but is ALSO inadmissible for rule 232 at every executed n_dev (maximum 0.5, at L = 8). DISCLOSED POST-HOC DIAGNOSTIC (not part of the frozen prediction): the cause is the record's own declared DENSE budget cap of 16 trajectories, not representability. Raising only the perceptron passes from 5 to 20, 80 and 200 at the 16-trajectory cap changes nothing (0.5 at L = 8, 0.0625 at L = 16 throughout), so the optimizer has converged; raising the trajectory cap instead gives rule 232 capability 0.5 / 0.9375 / 1.0 at 16 / 64 / 256 trajectories at L = 8 and 0.0625 / 0.6875 / 1.0 at L = 16. The clause was self-defeating as written: it predicted admissibility at n_dev <= 16 while the same record capped DENSE's training at 16 trajectories. (8) HOLDS, and with a stronger certificate than a grid. The analytic crossover set between FIELD and FIELD_NONLOCAL is EMPTY in all 288 (cell, price) pairs because their per-query costs are identical under both price vectors; and a checked uniform-domination certificate holds in all 288 pairs — FIELD's fixed cost AND its per-query cost are each <= those of every admissible row. No grid truncation can therefore hide a frontier cell, so DG-2 is discharged by domination rather than by grid extension. FIELD is the sole frontier occupant of every non-empty frontier entry (1144 of 1152); the 8 empty entries are L8_r232_n1, where no row is admissible. (9) HOLDS. The weight-sharing-ablated parent reproduces FIELD's answers EXACTLY in 60 of 144 cells — exactly those in which it has identified enough of its per-site tables — at an overhead of exactly L in description and 8 to 128 in samples, both polynomial in the state size. Criterion 3 fails for DC2. OVERALL: 4 of 9 clauses hold exactly (2, 3, 8, 9), 5 fail in part (1, 4, 5, 6, 7) and every failure is a prediction-writing or ecology-construction error, not a result favouring the candidate; not one failure moves DC2 toward being a domain.
failure_class: prediction-writing errors (clause 1 assumed one trajectory always identifies the rule, which fails for the majority rule at L = 8; clause 4 asserted an 'if and only if' where full identification is only sufficient; clause 5 inherited clause 1's error; clause 7 predicted DENSE admissibility at n_dev <= 16 while the same record capped DENSE's training at 16 trajectories, making the clause unsatisfiable by construction) and one ecology-construction error (clause 6: at L = 8 the 256-member configuration space makes development and evaluation initials overlap from n_dev = 4 upward, so the 'unseen configuration' obligation is not met in 28 of 144 cells)
strongest_mundane_explanation: the two field rows search the same hypothesis class and, once both have identified it, execute the same rule at every site, so they cannot differ on any answer; everything the microscope measures is the cost of NOT sharing a parameter — L times the description and a coupon-collector factor in the samples, because the shared row collects L constraint observations per lattice update while the unshared row collects one per site
strongest_parent_explanation: theory core L3 then L4 with the B1-A symmetry mechanism: the shared local rule is a symmetry constraint on a D6 iterated local map. Admissibility is decided by identifiability (how many observations are needed to pin the rule table), then cost by description. This is the same shape as RV-377-044's lazy/eager crossover, with the axis being a symmetry group rather than structure depth
measurement_validity_status: valid at L >= 16, where the unseen-configuration obligation holds in all 116 cells and TABLE is 0.0 everywhere; DEGRADED at L = 8, where 28 cells violate the disjointness of development and evaluation initials and TABLE scores up to 0.75 on genuine repeats. Exact charged replay throughout; FIELD and FIELD_NONLOCAL execute identical charged op sequences per query, so the entire FIELD/FIELD_NONLOCAL gap is attributable to weight sharing alone; the native price is declared, not measured; the search is realized by early-exit filtering whose surviving set equals the exhaustive search's consistent set, with the exhaustive op count reported separately; n* values are resolved only to the next point of the declared n_dev grid {1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256}; the DENSE row carries a declared 16-trajectory training cap, so its frontier position at large n_dev is UNMEASURED in this receipt (open, non-blocking)
mechanism_attribution: weight sharing, and nothing else. Identifiability: one synchronous lattice update yields L constraint observations for the shared row and one per site for the unshared row, so the unshared row pays a coupon-collector factor that grows with L (executed 8 to 128). Description: 8 bits against 8L, exactly the parameter count of the symmetry orbit against the free parameterization. Serve: identical — 11 ops per site, 33L per query, 3 STEPs at the native price, in both rows. Locality is a second, separable mechanism: the DENSE row, which keeps neither locality nor sharing, needs 64 to 256 trajectories for the one rule it can represent (232) and never reaches admissibility on the three it cannot (110, 30, 90)
new_invariant_learned: at scope: (i) the field row and the weight-sharing-ablated row are developmentally IDENTICAL exactly when the ablated row is capable (answer-signature equality <=> capability 1.0, 144/144 cells) — full identification is sufficient but not necessary, because unexercised table entries do not affect the served answers; (ii) the description separation is EXACTLY L, independent of rule, n_dev and horizon; (iii) the serve separation is EXACTLY ZERO under both price vectors, so the two rows admit no finite reuse-horizon crossover and the field row dominates uniformly in H; (iv) the sample separation is the only other content of the carrier and is 8 to 128 over L in {8,...,64}, growing with L at fixed rule; (v) the sample cost of the hypothesis class itself is rule-dependent (rule 110 costs the unshared row 4x more trajectories than rule 30 at the same L), so sample efficiency is a property of the symmetry AND the dynamics, not of L alone
new_theory_constraint: a carrier whose only separations from its ablated parent are (a) a description factor equal to the size of the symmetry orbit and (b) a sample factor from the same orbit, with IDENTICAL serve cost, cannot be a structural domain under criterion 3: it is the symmetry-constrained phase of its parent, and the reduction is not merely bounded but free at serve time. DG-2 gains a second, cheaper discharge route: when one row's fixed AND per-query costs both dominate, the 'no cell exists' clause is settled by a UNIFORM-DOMINATION CERTIFICATE and needs no grid extension at all; an extended grid is required only when the per-query costs cross. A third constraint is instrumental: a finite ecology must have its configuration space checked against n_dev (the L = 8 failure), and a row carrying a declared training budget cap must not have admissibility predicted at or below that cap
claim_movement: DC2 -> REDUCED_TO_PARENT(D6 + translation-equivariant weight sharing) at scope, with exact developmental equality executed and a zero serve-cost separation; the programme-level prediction of GMI_DOMAIN_CANDIDATES_DC1_DC9_V1 section 4 is upheld for DC2 and SHARPENED — where DC1 and DC3 reduce with a nonzero crossover, DC2 reduces with no crossover at all. Theory core L3/L4 gains the symmetry axis alongside RV-377-044's structure-depth axis. Gap DG-2 gains the uniform-domination discharge; a new non-blocking hole is opened (DENSE's frontier position beyond its 16-trajectory cap) and the L = 8 ecology defect is recorded
